text: Computed result for ARK is identical (verified: the only other `max-width` rules in ARK target `.ark-topbar__inner`, `.ark-content-area`, `.ark-content--standalone`, `.ark-region-footer__inner`, `.ark-region-footer-bar__inner` — none is a section). Non-ARK themes never declared the token, so the `none` fallback plus `width: 100%` resolves the auto margins to zero — a no-op.
